follow-up time: Variable, up to 192 days after pregnancy termination
exposure: pregnancy termination in the second trimester
Prenatal vs. postnatal diagnosis of PAS
Pregnancy termination in the second trimester
cohort: 29 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders who underwent pregnancy termination in the second trimester
finding: Leaving the implanted placenta in situ after pregnancy termination in the second trimester in patients with PAS disorders is a viable option for uterus preservation, potentially allowing for future pregnancies without recurrent PAS disorders.
